title: 3rd Stopping Place 3rd Truth Applying The Spring Army And The Travelers Judgment On Resurrection

questions.question: After reading about one spring, what did the traveler think about people who deny being raised again after death?
questions.answer: He thought they deserve the punishment of Hell because they reject a true promise.

questions.question: What big belief are those people denying?
questions.answer: They are denying resurrection and the gathering.

questions.question: Why is that denial called a serious mistake in the passage?
questions.answer: Because it goes against many promises from Allah and denies His power.

questions.question: Who made those promises?
questions.answer: Allah made them.

questions.question: How many times were these promises given through the prophets?
questions.answer: Many times, even thousands of times.

questions.question: Where else are these promises told besides through the prophets?
questions.answer: In many verses of the Qur’an.

questions.question: According to the passage, is resurrection hard or easy for Allah?
questions.answer: It is easy for Allah.

questions.question: What example is given to help us understand this?
questions.answer: The amazing coming back of life in spring.

questions.question: How are the spring events compared with the final gathering?
questions.answer: Spring shows many wonderful gatherings, and the final gathering is even greater.

questions.question: What does the traveler’s nafs say back to him?
questions.answer: It says that it believes.

questions.question: What was the traveler looking at before he spoke to himself?
questions.answer: He was thinking about one spring as a sign.

questions.question: What lesson did he take from that spring?
questions.answer: He learned that resurrection is real.

questions.question: What happens when a person says resurrection is not true?
questions.answer: That person rejects Allah’s promises and power.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about Allah’s power?
questions.answer: Allah has complete power to bring people back to life.

questions.question: How does the Qur’an support this teaching?
questions.answer: It mentions resurrection many times.

questions.question: Besides the Qur’an, who else brought this message?
questions.answer: The prophets brought it.

questions.question: Which is used as a sign we can see again and again: spring or winter?
questions.answer: Spring.

questions.question: Why is spring a good sign for resurrection?
questions.answer: Because many living things appear again in a wonderful way.

questions.question: At the end, how does the nafs respond?
questions.answer: It accepts the truth and says it believes.

questions.question: In the passage, what does the traveler say is fair for deniers of resurrection?
questions.answer: He says punishment in Hell is fair for them.

questions.question: What truth are they refusing to accept?
questions.answer: That Allah will raise people again and gather them.

questions.question: What two things does this refusal go against?
questions.answer: Allah’s promises and Allah’s power.

questions.question: How often had Allah’s prophets told this message?
questions.answer: Very often, thousands of times.

questions.question: What holy book is named as giving this message too?
questions.answer: The Qur’an.

questions.question: Does the passage say the Qur’an speaks clearly only, or clearly and also in hints?
questions.answer: Clearly and also in hints.

questions.question: What does the passage say about how hard resurrection is for Allah?
questions.answer: It says it is very easy for Him.

questions.question: What natural event is used to show that Allah can do this?
questions.answer: The life that returns in spring.

questions.question: What final answer comes from the nafs?
questions.answer: It says, “We believe.”

questions.question: Who is talking to himself in the passage?
questions.answer: The traveler is.

questions.question: What subject is he thinking about?
questions.answer: He is thinking about resurrection.

questions.question: What does he say about people who deny it?
questions.answer: He says their punishment is just.

questions.question: Why does he say denying resurrection is not a small matter?
questions.answer: Because it means calling Allah’s repeated promises untrue.

questions.question: What does the passage show about Allah’s strength?
questions.answer: His strength is perfect and complete.

questions.question: Through whom were the promises shared with people?
questions.answer: Through all of Allah’s prophets.

questions.question: About how many times does the passage say this promise was given?
questions.answer: Thousands of times.

questions.question: What yearly sign shows many amazing acts like being brought back?
questions.answer: Spring does.

questions.question: What choice does the nafs make in the end?
questions.answer: It chooses belief.

questions.question: What did the traveler read that made him think deeply?
questions.answer: He read one page of the signs of spring.

questions.question: What belief did he defend after that?
questions.answer: He defended belief in resurrection.

questions.question: What punishment did he mention for rejecting this belief?
questions.answer: He mentioned the punishment of Hell.

questions.question: What makes that punishment fair, according to the passage?
questions.answer: The person is rejecting clear truth from Allah.

questions.question: What has Allah done many times about resurrection?
questions.answer: He has promised it many times.

questions.question: Where can a Muslim find those promises?
questions.answer: In the messages of the prophets and in the Qur’an.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah bringing the final gathering?
questions.answer: Allah can do it easily.

questions.question: What repeated event in the world helps prove that?
questions.answer: The wonderful return of life in spring.

questions.question: Which is greater in the passage: the spring gatherings or the final gathering?
questions.answer: The final gathering is greater.

questions.question: How does the nafs answer the traveler’s words?
questions.answer: It agrees and believes.

questions.question: After seeing the sign of spring, what did the traveler become more sure about?
questions.answer: He became more sure about resurrection.

questions.question: What wrong action is spoken against in the passage?
questions.answer: Denying resurrection.

questions.question: What does such denial say about Allah’s promises?
questions.answer: It treats them as if they are not true.

questions.question: What does such denial say about Allah’s ability?
questions.answer: It wrongly acts like His power is not enough.

questions.question: Who gave people this message from Allah over and over?
questions.answer: The prophets did.

questions.question: What book also gives this message many times?
questions.answer: The Qur’an does.

questions.question: What does the passage teach by comparing resurrection with spring?
questions.answer: If Allah brings life back in spring, He can raise people after death.

questions.question: What does the traveler’s thinking show about using signs in the world?
questions.answer: It shows that signs in creation can strengthen faith.

questions.question: What is the short reply from the nafs at the end?
questions.answer: It says it believes.
